Just WOW. Fun intense problem solving using real commands. (Even if the hacking tools are a bit out there) Did not expect the story to be nearly as good as it was and [spoiler]avenging Bit and killing off HackNet was a great way for things to end. My first instinct after that audio clip was to delete the game.[spoiler] Overall highly recommend though I would keep a notebook and pen handy especially for the later missions.
One of the best hacking games out there, well worth the money

Before this game I was extremely averse to any idea of coding (scratch trauma). The game really walked me through what commands are and how to generally use them without directly giving me the answers, the directory function was super helpful. 

I felt like I could actually visualize myself going through different files and directories without feeling totally lost like I used to. Sure it might be unrealistic to a real "hacking scenario", but how would I know that! Anyways I'm taking a python class now and this game helped me understand the basic concepts and how to move through files a lot better. 

This game was frustrating initially for someone who knew literally nothing about coding in the beginning, but it was like a puzzle I got to figure out over time which was really rewarding. I would recommend this game if your thinking about trying coding. 5 stars!!!

Hacknet is a fun hacking simulator that is slightly reminiscent of the 90s and early 2000s "hacking" movies and shows with the flashy GUI "hacking" visuals.  It  some well thought out puzzles, and the terminal will be familiar enough to anyone who is accustomed to Linux or UNIX terminal commands.

Provided me about 15 hours of entertainment, but I could see someone putting in 25-30 hours with multiple playthroughs, doing all the different contracts, and looking for any hidden tidbits.

I got this game on sale, and I feel comfortable saying I would have been happy purchasing this game at full price.  If this type of game is something that interests you, I would highly recommend it.
